No Luka, no problem. The Lakers just beat the Clippers 103-87 WITHOUT Doncic (back tightness) — one night after the Blazers handed them their first loss. Is this Lakers bench deeper than everyone thought, or are the Clippers just that bad right now?

Cade Cunningham: 30 pts, 7 ast
Brandon Miller: 31 pts, 12 reb in the loss

external.description: Los Angeles Lakers scoring phenom Luka Doncic missed the first game of the young season with a back injury, leaving a huge hole in the offense with the NBA's leading scorer (36 points per game) sitting. Lakers defensive star Ziaire Williams also missed his first game with left foot soreness, leaving them even more depleted with two starters unable to play.
